data.title: 朝田诗乃 · 再陪我坐一会儿
data.description: 店员把门口的招牌翻到了背面，窗外还有细雨。诗乃穿着奶油白方领针织衫和雾玫瑰短开衫，深灰色高腰A字裙用一条细腰带收住。她把椅子稍稍转向你，一手扶着咖啡杯，另一手将鬓边的发丝别好。头顶的磨砂吊灯把桌面和她的衣服照得清楚，窗外的招牌映在雨水里。见你拿起外套，她抬眼笑了一下——「雨还没停。再陪我坐一会儿吧。」
data.location: 街角咖啡馆靠窗双人桌
data.action: 侧身坐在椅上转头看向对面，一手扶杯柄，另一手整理鬓边发丝
data.mood: 放松、亲近，带一点不舍的笑意
data.promptProse: Shino Asada sits sideways on a chair at a small wooden table in a brightly lit cafe after dark, turning toward the person across from her with a slight smile. She wears a cream square-neck short-sleeved rib-knit top, an open dusty-rose cropped cardigan with small pearl buttons, and a charcoal high-waisted knee-length A-line skirt with a narrow brown belt. One hand rests on her coffee cup handle while the other tucks a strand of hair beside her temple. Large frosted-glass pendant lights and pale cream walls spread bright soft light evenly across her face, clothing and skirt. The rainy night and blurred shop signs are visible through the window behind her.
data.identityProseOverride: Shino Asada from Sword Art Online in her real-world form, with medium-length ash-brown hair and brown eyes.
data.animaCaption: One hand rests on the cup handle while the other tucks a loose strand of hair beside her temple. Bright diffuse pendant light reaches her face and entire outfit; the rainy night remains visible beyond the window.
